definitions.consensus: Mean of +2/+1/0/-1/-2 weights over all covering analysts, bucketed at +/-0.3 and +/-1.0.
definitions.mom_change_pp: Change in buy_side_pct versus the prior month, in percentage points.
definitions.direction: IMPROVING at >= +2.0pp, DETERIORATING at <= -2.0pp, else STABLE.
definitions.age_days: Days from the period date (first of month) to generated_at.
